source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of annihilation reactions with Example 19.4 (PDF 151-152, printed 147-148).

blocks.text: Positron-electron pair ka annihilation hum pichhle chapter mein parh chuke hain. Asal mein annihilation tab hota hai jab koi particle aur us ka antiparticle ek doosre ke qareeb aate hain: dono khatam ho jate hain aur un ka mass-energy photons ban jata hai. Is process mein mass-energy aur momentum dono conserve rehte hain.

Elementary particles ki research (tehqeeq) ke liye bohat zyada energy chahiye. Is liye particles ko un ki rest mass energy par takrane ke bajaye roshni ki speed ke qareeb tak tez kar ke takraya jata hai. CERN ke Large Hadron Collider (LHC) mein protons aur bhari nuclei roshni ki speed ke qareeb takraye jate hain taake early universe (shuru ki kainaat) jaise halaat ban saken. TeV order ki energy wali yeh takkaren early universe ko samajhne mein madad deti hain. Aisi takkaron mein electro-weak force ke mediator particles W⁺, W⁻ aur Z bosons, jin ki prediction (pehle se khabar) Prof. Abdus Salam ne di thi, discover hue; saath top aur bottom quarks bhi mile, aur sab se ahem Higgs boson July 2012 mein discover hua.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke LHC mein proton aur antiproton takraye jate hain. LHC protons ko protons se (aur lead jaise bhari nuclei ko aapas mein) takrata hai; proton-antiproton takkaren pehle CERN ke SPS aur Fermilab ke Tevatron mein hui thin (W aur Z bosons 1983 mein SPS par mile). Kitab W⁻ ko 'W⁻¹' bhi likhti hai.

blocks.alt: Collision point (takkar ki jagah) par W/Z boson, jis ke gird chhote particles bikhre hain, aik W/Z boson aur Higgs boson h mein batta hai. W/Z se quark q aur antiquark q-bar, aur h se b aur b-bar quarks bante hain. Har quark particles ki aik bauchhar mein khatam hota hai: Jet 1, Jet 2, Jet 3, Jet 4.
blocks.caption: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: p+ aur p- ki collision (takkar) ka schematic diagram (kitab ke box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Takkar se W/Z boson banta hai jo aik W/Z aur Higgs boson (h) mein badalta hai. W/Z quark aur antiquark (q, q-bar) mein, aur h bottom quark ke jore (b, b-bar) mein badalta hai; har quark particles ki aik 'jet' banata hai jise detector pakarta hai.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Kitab CMS detector mein 7 TeV proton-proton takkar ki tasveer dikhati hai jis mein 100 se zyada charged particles bane.

blocks.title: Example 19.4
blocks.problem: Electron-positron pair ke annihilation mein nikalne wale gamma ray photons ki energy nikalein.
steps: Positron ka mass = electron ka mass = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg
Einstein ki mass-energy relation: E = 2mc² = 2 × 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg × (3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)²
blocks.answer: Do γ-ray photons nikalte hain, har ek 0.51 MeV ka, opposite (ulti) directions mein, taake momentum conserve rahe.

blocks.alt: Electron e- aur positron e+ aik doosre ki taraf aa kar khatam hote hain; takkar ki jagah se do gamma photons, har aik 0.51 MeV, opposite directions (oopar aur neeche) mein nikalte hain; E = 2moc^2 = 1.02 MeV.
blocks.caption: Electron-positron annihilation (asal khaaka; kitab mein is ki koi shakal nahi).

blocks.text: Body (jism) ke andar annihilation se nikalne wale gamma-ray photons itni energy rakhte hain ke body se bahar nikal aate hain, is liye unhein body ke bahar detectors pakad sakte hain. Positron emission tomography (PET) isi par kaam karti hai: positron emit karne (chhorne) wala tracer body mein dala jata hai; har positron jaldi kisi electron se mil kar khatam hota hai, aur opposite directions mein jane wali 0.51 MeV ki do gamma rays mareez ke gird detectors ki ring pakad leti hai.

blocks.prompt: Electron-positron annihilation ke do photons opposite directions mein kyun nikalte hain?
blocks.explanation: Annihilation se pehle pair ka kul momentum taqreeban zero hai. Momentum conserve rakhne ke liye do photons ka momentum barabar aur ulta hona chahiye: barabar energy (har ek 0.51 MeV) aur opposite directions.

items: Annihilation: particle + antiparticle → photons; mass-energy aur momentum conserve.
e⁻ + e⁺ → do gamma rays, har ek 0.51 MeV, opposite directions mein (E = 2mc² = 1.02 MeV).
LHC (proton-proton): W, Z bosons (Abdus Salam ki prediction), Higgs boson (2012); PET annihilation istemal karti hai.
